SCENE sc_001 0-26700 INT. CATHERINE'S CHAMBERS – NIGHT
EP48:E1 0-4500 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking slightly as Catherine stands beside a tall mullioned stone window, silhouetted against the moonlight over the distant castle spires.
EP48:E2 0-3000 ACTION: Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.
EP48:E3 2400-7500 CATHERINE [Vindictive, Cold]: "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."
EP48:E4 4500-8500 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.
EP48:E5 7800-12300 ACTION: Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.
EP48:E6 8000-12300 CATHERINE [Scheming]: "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."
EP48:E7 12300-20000 CAMERA: Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.
EP48:E8 12600-14900 CATHERINE [Intense, Measured]: "Ten days for the council to sit."
EP48:E9 15000-18500 ACTION: Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.
EP48:E10 15100-17200 CATHERINE [Calculating]: "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."
EP48:E11 17400-19700 CATHERINE [Dark, Threatening]: "Ten days for a decree to be undone."
EP48:E12 20000-26700 CAMERA: Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.
EP48:E13 20100-23700 CATHERINE [Menacing, Resolute]: "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."
EP48:E14 23900-26500 CATHERINE [Chillingly Calm]: "And doors can be closed from the other side."
SCENE sc_002 26700-80000 INT. CATHERINE'S CHAMBERS – CONTINUOUS
EP48:E15 26700-30800 CAMERA: Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.
EP48:E16 26800-29500 ACTION: Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.
EP48:E17 29200-30800 AGNES [Hushed, Submissive]: "You sent for me, my lady?"
EP48:E18 30900-32000 CATHERINE [Commanding, Sharp]: "Lock it."
EP48:E19 32000-33900 CAMERA: Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.
EP48:E20 32300-33800 SOUND: Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
EP48:E21 34000-36500 ACTION: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
EP48:E22 34000-43000 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.
EP48:E23 34200-37100 CATHERINE [Fierce, Hissing]: "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
EP48:E24 37300-39000 CATHERINE [Spiteful, calculating]: "Good. Let them remember it."
EP48:E25 39200-43000 CATHERINE [Sinister, Predatory]: "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
EP48:E26 43000-46800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.
EP48:E27 43300-46800 AGNES [Anxious, Whispering]: "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
EP48:E28 46800-51500 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.
EP48:E29 47000-51300 CATHERINE [Confident, Devious]: "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
EP48:E30 51500-58200 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.
EP48:E31 52000-55000 CATHERINE [Pleased, Scheming]: "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
EP48:E32 55200-58200 CATHERINE [Calculated, Demanding]: "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
EP48:E33 58200-61000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.
EP48:E34 58500-60600 AGNES [Apprehensive]: "If someone sees him come to you..."
EP48:E35 61000-66900 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.
EP48:E36 61800-64000 CATHERINE [Stern, Threatening]: "Then no one sees him."
EP48:E37 64300-66900 CATHERINE [Authoritative]: "That is precisely your job tonight."
EP48:E38 66900-73500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
EP48:E39 67500-69000 SOUND: Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
EP48:E40 67800-70500 CATHERINE [Hushed, Commanding]: "Send for the priest. Tonight."
EP48:E41 70800-73400 CATHERINE [Firm, Final]: "And make sure no one sees him arrive."
EP48:E42 73500-76800 CAMERA: Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.
EP48:E43 76800-80000 CAMERA: Exterior shot looking through the dark diamond-paned window frame at Catherine standing motionless in the warm candlelight, staring outward into the night with cold, unyielding ambition as the scene fades to black.
